recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized 3D character with multiple limbs positioned in a Vitruvian Man pose, encased within a complex chrome astrological armillary sphere against a grainy sunset gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: The character is centered within concentric metallic rings.
The multi-armed figure aligns with the radial spokes of the astrological wheel.
Warm orange highlights on the character's hair and skin contrast with the cool purple and blue of the latex suit.
The astrological symbols are etched or floating along the perimeter of the chrome structure.
coreInvariants: Vitruvian-style limb duplication (four arms, four legs).
High-gloss black latex texture on the figure's clothing.
Chrome or polished silver material for the celestial rings.
Grainy, dithered gradient background transitioning from orange to purple.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally placed, full-body figure occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The character's face with glowing glasses and bright orange hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Radial movement starting from the center outward along the spokes, then circular movement following the tilted rings.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniformly textured gradient background providing high contrast for the complex central silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and black (latex suit and upper sky).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange (hair and lower sky gradient).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Chrome silver and magenta (metallic rings and lighting reflections).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the hair and sky; high value contrast between the black suit and the metallic highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid naturalistic skin tones; use stylized, saturated hues.
Limit background to a two-tone vertical gradient.

letterConstructionRules: Geometric construction of zodiac signs (Leo, Cancer, etc.).
Small numeric coordinates placed adjacent to symbols.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Zodiac symbols integrated into the circular paths of the armillary sphere.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Iconographic symbols paired with small, sans-serif technical numerals.

candidateDirections.reason: Maintains the celestial theme of the composition.
For the degree numbers to suggest a scientific instrument.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D stylized character with orange dreadlocks and four arms/legs in a Vitruvian pose, wearing a black latex suit, centered inside a complex chrome armillary sphere. The background is a grainy sunset gradient from orange to purple.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin white astrological symbols and small degree numbers along the outer chrome ring and inner radial lines using vector outlines.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly four arms and four legs?
Is the latex suit highly reflective?
Do the rings have a metallic chrome finish?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Any brand logos on the clothing

mustAchieve: Perfect radial symmetry in the sphere

postGenerationChecks: Ensure chrome reflections match the background light source.
Verify symbols are legible and follow the circular paths.
Confirm the grain texture is uniform across the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central multi-limbed figure + chrome celestial apparatus + vaporwave gradient background + astrological iconography.
